candidates.change_summary: Replace return true with return false so the return value is always false instead of always true.
Replace the keccak256 selector to a different function, e.g. 'transfer(address,uint256)', so that the external low-level calls target a different method than transferFrom.
Remove the for-loop body entirely, replacing it with a 'continue;' so that no external calls are made but the function still returns true.
Delete the 'require' statement so that the function executes even when _tos is empty, changing revert behavior and subsequent state.
Replace the function return value 'true' with 'false' so the return value changes under all non-reverting paths.
Replace the for-loop condition to iterate only once (i<1) so that only the first target address receives the call.
Replace the 'from' argument in the encoding with 'msg.sender' so that the caller becomes the source in transferFrom instead of the parameter.
